Anant Singh Daughter Wedding:anant sinhki beti ki shadi men khane ke lie machi chhina-jhapti!|Shivangi Singh
Aur ab bat lut vali mansikta ki...mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ne apni chhoti beti shivangi ki shadi men sabko khula aamantran de diya...unhonne kaha, jise aana hai vo aae...aur jitna man utna khae...bas phir kya tha..25 nanvbar ko nadavan men aisi bhir juti...jise dekhkar sabhi hairan rah gae...par hairani bhir ki tadad par nahin...unki lut-khasot vali mansikta par huee...kaee vidiyo vayral hue jismen log khane ke lie ek dusre ko dhakka dete hue najar aae
